title: Moonlex 12V to 24V DC LDR-BATTERY operated Day Night Sensor Auto On-Off Photocell Sensor for DC Lights or Solar lights | Turn Light ON in Night and OFF In Morning. Useful for DC current BATTERY 12V to 24 V
description: The Moonlex DC Day Night Sensor (DC LDR Sensor) is a compact and energy-efficient automatic light control switch designed for 7V to 24V DC powered lighting systems. It automatically turns connected lights ON at dusk and OFF at dawn, eliminating the need for manual switching while saving battery power and electricity. Built with a high-sensitivity light-dependent resistor (LDR), the sensor accurately detects ambient light levels and controls the connected load accordingly. It is ideal for solar lighting systems, battery-operated lights, LED strips, sign boards, garden lights, CCTV illuminators, decorative lighting, and various low-voltage DC applications. The sensor supports a wide input voltage range of 7V to 24V DC and is easy to install using simple input and output wiring. Manufactured with high-quality electronic components, the Moonlex DC LDR Sensor provides reliable performance, long service life, and stable operation in outdoor and indoor environments.
